name: PMO Audit Findings
query:
SELECT
    name AS "Finding:Link/PMO Audit Finding:220",
    engagement AS "Audit Engagement:Link/PMO Audit Engagement:220",
    finding_title AS "Finding Title:Data:260",
    rating AS "Rating:Data:110",
    status AS "Status:Data:140"
FROM `tabPMO Audit Finding`
ORDER BY
    CASE rating
        WHEN 'Critical' THEN 1
        WHEN 'High' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Medium' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Low' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
    END,
    finding_title
